structure.note: Blackstone Inc. common stock is listed; Blackstone personnel and others also hold partnership units of the Blackstone Holdings partnerships, exchangeable one-for-one for common stock. Stephen A. Schwarzman holds no common stock but 231,924,793 partnership units (52.2% of that class). The single share of Series I preferred stock, owned by Blackstone Partners L.L.C. (controlled by Mr. Schwarzman), carries votes equal to all vested and unvested partnership units held by limited partners, about 37.5% of the combined vote as of February 20, 2026. The Series II preferred stockholder holds more than 50% of the voting power for the election of directors, and the 10-K says Blackstone is therefore a 'controlled company' under NYSE rules.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Blackstone files no DEF 14A; ownership is from Item 12 of the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-082531, filed February 27, 2026), as of February 20, 2026. Mr. Schwarzman is Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO. BASIS: he owns no Blackstone Inc. common stock, so his share of the listed common stock alone is 0%. His economic interest is in Blackstone Holdings partnership units, which share in Blackstone's earnings alongside the common stock and can be exchanged for it one-for-one. The record therefore uses a derived figure of 19.42% of common stock plus limited partners' participating units (see derived.method; about 18.9% if unvested participating common stock is added). The units he holds include 3,686,266 units in trusts for which he is investment trustee (beneficial ownership disclaimed) and 12,368,074 vested units held back under minimum retained ownership requirements. pctVoting is null because the filing gives no personal voting percentage: the 37.5% Series I vote belongs to Blackstone Partners L.L.C., which he controls, and the Series II holder's majority vote for directors belongs to Blackstone Group Management L.L.C. HOLDERS: Vanguard (8.5%) and BlackRock (6.2%), from 2024 Schedule 13G filings, are measured as % of common stock only, so they are recorded with basis 'class' and never used to compute everyone else. Jonathan D. Gray holds 41,293,901 units (9.3% of units) and 2,270,041 shares. DIVIDENDS: $3,635.7m of capital distributions to Blackstone Inc. common stockholders in 2025, from the equity statement. The cash-flow line 'Dividends/Distributions to Stockholders and Unitholders' is $6,013.4m and also includes distributions to Blackstone Holdings unitholders, which are non-controlling interests ($2,394.1m in the equity statement), so it is not used; on the derived ownership basis, which includes the units, about $6.01 billion went to stockholders and unitholders together. BUYBACKS: $122.6m of common stock repurchases (0.8 million shares). STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back for equity-based compensation. PLAN: null; no broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY: null because the segment note gives only percentages of total GAAP revenues by region, attributed by the geography of investments held: Americas 80%, Europe, Middle East and Africa 13%, Asia-Pacific 7% (2025); domestically generated revenues were 68% of total GAAP revenues. No dollar amounts by region are given, so none are derived.

marketcap.notes: Common stock is listed on the NYSE as BX; the 10-Q cover count at October 30, 2026 is the latest. JUDGMENT CALL: the Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units held by limited partners are included as a second class because they are the other half of the economic interest in Blackstone (noncontrolling interests in Blackstone Holdings, exchangeable one-for-one for common stock and paid the same distributions), and the leader's ownership figure is measured on common stock plus these units; the count is the participating units at September 30, 2026, the latest stated. A market cap on common stock alone would leave them out. Unvested participating common stock (39,575,922 at September 30, 2026) is not counted separately because the cover count is of shares outstanding. The single share each of Series I and Series II preferred stock carry votes only and are left out.
